integrity.claim_basis: Exact reconstruction from the published facet list, exhaustive finite enumeration, and an integral determinant certificate.
integrity.computational_scope: All 220 vertex triples and all six elements generated by the published symmetry generators are checked exhaustively.
integrity.unproved_limits: No uniqueness claim for the 12-vertex triangulation and no classification of longer cycles.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the exact labeled 12-vertex complex listed by Lutz and does not assert uniqueness among all triangulations of the lens space.
Only shortest simple integral first-homology cycles are classified; longer representatives are outside scope.

The 1999 dissertation is earlier than the metadata date but the inspected evidence resolves it only to the year; 2003-11-07 is the earliest inspected day-resolved public date and no artificial 1999 day is assigned.
An unindexed historical finite computation could in principle contain the same orbit census or homology-action observation.
title: Symmetry-fixed one-systoles and the sign action on \(H_1\) of the 12-vertex lens space
